english.note: Use this for an engineering or technical specialist when the professional title or technical qualification is being emphasized rather than engineering in general.

examples.english: They have an engineer's qualification and specialize in repairing air conditioners.
examples.traditional: 佢有技師資格，專門維修冷氣機。
